title: Basic Shop - Gameplay Prototype
subtitle: Implementation of an exchange mechanic for 2D games
description:
This project is based on the implementation of a logic system for a store, which includes interaction, buying and selling mechanics through an interface. It was developed as a programming and development practice in Unity for the university course of 2D Development.

To improve the final result, I incorporated my own recycled character art, adding animations and pose variations to the characters interacting in the store.
